title: Disappointed
text: Disappointed. The spikes on the grabber were not long enough to hold a potato for slicing. When trying to slice large sweet potatoes, I had very hard time slicing lengthwise as the force to hold potato in place and make it go through slicer was way too much. Slicer better for vegetables and fruit. Major issue for me was that it was very difficult to clean under the blade, and mush from potatoes and others became lodged under blade which was not gone after washing or dishwasher. I had to use knife to clean out material. This is a design defect which needs correcting along with the grabber spikes. It did come with a glove that protected you from slicing your finger off....which I almost did in the 1970's when product concept first came out. That slicer was so sharp it would go right through your bones in a blink!! I haven't used one since I got hurt, so be careful!! Still, now I was to slice sweet potatoes for my dogs so I appreciated the glove they sent. They just need to improve on some design features. It was pretty though and would recommend for vegetables.
